claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: RHC-80267 is a diacylglycerol lipase inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its annotated pharmacology (DAGL inhibition) is not a lethal mechanism in cancer cells and no cytotoxic off-target is evident at this concentration.
